description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). ln_pre/ln_post -> CenterScale = (x - per_token_mean) * gamma with PER-CHANNEL gamma (vector, init 1.0); still no std-division, no beta. Isolates per-channel scale from exp470's scalar version (which lost ~+0.05, confirming the per-channel affine bundle is load-bearing). Per-channel gamma is the only piece that changes LUT selection. If exp471 ~= exp453 -> per-channel scale is THE load-bearing piece and (center + per-channel scale, no beta/std) is a minimal sufficient pre-LUT norm. If still worse -> beta and/or std also matter. q_norm/k_norm/ln_final stay LayerNorm. Saves checkpoint.
